title: Question 7.1b: Testing Individual Reviews - Making Prediction
code_section: Testing - Making Prediction on Single Review (Line 360)
instruction: This code applies the trained model to make a prediction on the new review.
reveal: This uses the trained model to make a prediction on the single review. The `prediction` dataset will contain the original review text, the dummy label, and most importantly, a new "prediction" column with the model's guess (0 for negative, 1 for positive). This is the same `.transform()` method we used on the test set, but now applied to a single new review.
